displayName: Query HS code detail information for analysis reports — retrieve Chinese and English descriptions for a given HS (Harmonized System) code from customs data. Provides comprehensive product classification details to help trade professionals, analysts and import-export practitioners understand what products a specific HS code represents. Essential for tariff code lookup, product classification verification, customs code interpretation and trade data analysis preparation across global customs trade data.
